period_note: Income-statement line items (net_interest_income, etc.) are DISCRETE Q2,2021 figures from the FY2021 annual report's own retrospective 'Quarterly Performance' table -- SOLO-consistent, per the exact match already demonstrated for Q1,2021 in 2021_Q1.json (that table's Q1,2021 column reproduces the real solo interim filing exactly). This is used in preference to this quarter's own consolidated interim filing for the income statement, to keep the series on a consistent solo basis; a direct check confirms they genuinely differ (this single-page filing's own consolidated cumulative Jan-Jun'21 net profit is 818.57m per its P&L panel, vs solo Q1(289.99)+Q2(485.29)=775.28m from the annual table -- a real solo/consolidated gap, not a transcription error). BALANCE SHEET line items, by contrast, are CONSOLIDATED (see per-item note) because no solo balance sheet is available for this quarter at all -- flagged as the dataset's one interim-period basis exception. non_interest_and_investment_income bundles investment income (annual-table convention).
